shape: 2-portal NW-isolated arena (N gate on west wall + S gate at SE) with two clusters bridged by a center
description: Two-portal stage where the north gate sits on the west wall at Z≈-8 and the south gate sits at the SE corner. The NW half is a small cluster: 9rhrjf (north entry) + 15dm5d + 1tyryt (NW corner) + z5z7ve + h82ft4 + pqjitx (center bridge). The SE half is dense: 8ixyxy (south entry) + 8t36ha + u1ocae form a triangle, with 0hr3yu fanning to two SE pockets (1h9fhv + ivaxfv). pqjitx is the ONLY bridge between halves via 8t36ha.

portals.north: spawn_north at (-19.07, -8.08) — gate on the west (low-X) column, north of midline
portals.south: spawn_south at (18.96, 23.09) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column

anchors.description: center bridge - sole link to south cluster (matches pqjitx)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → center → se_clique_w → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops via the center bridge.
STRICT BRIDGE: center (pqjitx) is the only connection between the NW cluster and the SE cluster. Do not emit alternate routes.
NW LOOP: north_inner → w_up → nw_corner → n_arc → n_arc_s → center forms a 5-anchor perimeter loop.
SE TRIANGLE: south_inner + se_clique_w + se_clique_e — BFS picks the shorter side.
SE pockets (se_pocket_a, se_pocket_b) are 2-hop dead-ends off se_step — corner objectives.
